title: Actuarial Convention Note: Half-Year Interest on Money Moving Through a Whole Life Insurance Accumulation Deposit
content:
**Convention.** On an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy, money that moved through the dividend accumulation deposit in the 12 calendar months before the day the credit is processed earns interest for half a year:

1. where accumulation withdrawals are dated within those 12 months, the amounts withdrawn are credited for half a year, that is their total times **0.5** is added to the balance the rate applies to;
2. where no withdrawal is so dated but dividend deposit entries are, those deposits are credited for half a year the same way, their total times 0.5 being added to that balance;
3. otherwise only the balance shown is credited.

Only one of the two movements counts: withdrawals in the window take precedence, and deposits in the window count only where there is no withdrawal in it. A movement dated later than the same day of the month twelve months before the processing day is inside the window.

## Convention applied (hypothetical, balance shown 18000.00, rate 3.75%, credit processed March 10, 2026)

| Movements in the window | Half-year amount | Balance the rate applies to | Interest at 3.75% |
|---|---|---|---|
| Withdrawals of 1000.00 and 2000.00; a deposit of 900.00 | 1500.00 | 19500.00 | 731.25 |
| No withdrawal; deposit of 900.00 | 450.00 | 18450.00 | 691.88 |
| None | Nothing | 18000.00 | 675.00 |

The interest is rounded half up to the cent once, on the whole.
